subject: Shipped: faster sync, smarter defaults — v2.14
preheader: This release cuts sync latency on large workspaces, adds guardrails for bulk edits, and ships the quality-of-life fixes you voted for—read the highlights, then open full release notes on the site.

content.headline: What’s new in v2.14
content.subheadline: Performance you feel, defaults you can trust, and clearer errors when something blocks a run.
content.imagePrompt: Abstract data flow visualization with soft blue and teal gradients, nodes and lines suggesting sync, no readable text or UI chrome, modern tech illustration style

content.body: TL;DR — Sync is faster for orgs over 500k rows. Bulk actions now confirm destructive steps. API errors return a trace id you can paste to support.

items.heading: Faster sync
items.description: Incremental sync for connected repos—median job time down 40% in benchmarks.
items.imagePrompt: Abstract speed motif, motion streaks on dark slate, soft cyan glow, no text

items.heading: Safer bulk edits
items.description: Confirm before apply; dry-run preview shows row counts before commit.
items.imagePrompt: Shield and checkmark abstract shapes, tech palette, no readable labels

items.heading: Clearer errors
items.description: Every failed API call returns a trace id and doc link for common fixes.
items.imagePrompt: Stacked document layers with subtle alert icon silhouette, blurred, no words

content.headline: Under the hood
content.body: We rewrote the queue worker for fair scheduling and added backpressure when third-party APIs rate-limit—fewer timeouts during peak hours.
content.imagePrompt: Server room aisle with cool blue LED light, shallow depth of field, no readable labels on racks

content.headline: Upgrade when you are ready
content.description: v2.14 rolls out to all workspaces this week. No action required for standard plans.
